1	# Creating a command
2	
3	Commands are declared with `defineCommand`, `defineOption` and `defineArgument`, on top of `cliparse`. Options and arguments are validated and parsed by [Zod](https://zod.dev) schemas, and their types flow into the handler. The reasons behind this design are explained in [ADR 0001](../adr/adr-0001-rework-file-structure.md).
4	
5	Before writing a command, look at a similar one and copy its naming, file layout, output format and error messages. `src/commands/drain/` is a good example of a command group with shared arguments and options.
6	
7	## Example
8	
9	A fictional `clever coffee brew <blend>` subcommand, part of a `coffee` group (neither exists in the CLI). The `<blend>` argument is shared by several `coffee` subcommands, so it lives in `coffee.args.js`:
10	
11	```js
12	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.args.js
13	import { z } from 'zod';
14	import { defineArgument } from '../../lib/define-argument.js';
15	
16	export const blendArg = defineArgument({
17	  schema: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes'),
18	  description: 'Blend of coffee',
19	  placeholder: 'blend',
20	});
21	```
22	
23	`--shots`, `--milk` and `--topping` are only used by this subcommand, so they are defined inline. `--format` comes from `global.options.js`:
24	
25	```js
26	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.brew.command.js
27	import { z } from 'zod';
28	import { brewCoffee } from '../../clever-client/coffee.js';
29	import { defineCommand } from '../../lib/define-command.js';
30	import { defineOption } from '../../lib/define-option.js';
31	import { Logger } from '../../logger.js';
32	import { sendToApi } from '../../models/send-to-api.js';
33	import { humanJsonOutputFormatOption } from '../global.options.js';
34	import { blendArg } from './coffee.args.js';
35	
36	export const coffeeBrewCommand = defineCommand({
37	  description: 'Brew a coffee',
38	  since: null,
39	  options: {
40	    shots: defineOption({
41	      name: 'shots',
42	      schema: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(4).default(1),
43	      description: 'Number of espresso shots',
44	      aliases: ['s'],
45	      placeholder: 'shots',
46	    }),
47	    milk: defineOption({
48	      name: 'milk',
49	      schema: z.enum(['none', 'whole', 'oat']).default('none'),
50	      description: 'Kind of milk',
51	      placeholder: 'milk',
52	    }),
53	    toppings: defineOption({
54	      name: 'topping',
55	      schema: z
56	        .union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())])
57	        .transform((value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? [value] : value))
58	        .optional(),
59	      description: 'Topping to add. Multiple --topping can be passed',
60	      placeholder: 'topping',
61	    }),
62	    format: humanJsonOutputFormatOption,
63	  },
64	  args: [blendArg],
65	  async handler(options, blend) {
66	    const { shots, milk, toppings, format } = options;

1	import { getAllApplicationInstances } from '@clevercloud/client/esm/api/v4/instance.js';
2	import { toDate } from '../lib/date-utils.js';
3	import { sendToApi } from './send-to-api.js';
4	
5	// States in which the VM is running
6	const RUNNING_STATES = [
7	  'BOOTING',
8	  'STARTING',
9	  'READY',
10	  'BUILDING',
11	  'DEPLOYING',
12	  'UP',
13	  'TASK_IN_PROGRESS',
14	  'MIGRATION_IN_PROGRESS',
15	  'STOPPING',
16	];
17	
18	/**
19	 * @typedef {object} Instance
20	 * @property {number} [instanceNumber] - Position of the instance within its deployment, starting at 0 (build VMs are also numbered 0), missing at the very beginning of booting
21	 * @property {string} id
22	 * @property {string|null} name
23	 * @property {string} state
24	 * @property {string|null} flavor
25	 * @property {boolean} isBuildVm
26	 * @property {string} deploymentId
27	 * @property {string} createdAt - ISO 8601 date
28	 * @property {string|null} deletedAt - ISO 8601 date
29	 */
30	
31	/**
32	 * Lists the instances of an application, sorted by creation date (oldest first).
33	 * The API returns the most recent instances first, so `limit` keeps the N most recent ones.
34	 * @param {object} params
35	 * @param {string} params.ownerId
36	 * @param {string} params.appId
37	 * @param {boolean} [params.onlyRunning] - Only keep instances whose VM is running
38	 * @param {Date} [params.since] - Only keep instances deleted at or after this date, or not deleted yet
39	 * @param {Date} [params.until] - Only keep instances created at or before this date
40	 * @param {string} [params.deploymentId] - Only keep instances created by this deployment
41	 * @param {number} [params.limit]
42	 * @returns {Promise<Array<Instance>>}
43	 */
44	export async function listInstances({ ownerId, appId, onlyRunning, since, until, deploymentId, limit }) {
45	  const rawInstances = await getAllApplicationInstances({
46	    ownerId,
47	    applicationId: appId,
48	    // The API rejects a repeated query parameter but accepts a comma-separated list
49	    includeState: onlyRunning ? RUNNING_STATES.join(',') : undefined,
50	    since: since?.toISOString(),
51	    until: until?.toISOString(),
52	    deploymentId,
53	    limit,
54	  }).then(sendToApi);
55	
56	  return rawInstances.map(normalizeInstance).sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
57	}
58	
59	/**
60	 * @param {object} rawInstance - Instance as returned by the v4 orchestration API
61	 * @returns {Instance}
62	 */
63	function normalizeInstance(rawInstance) {
64	  return {
65	    instanceNumber: rawInstance.index,
66	    id: rawInstance.id,
67	    name: rawInstance.name ?? null,
68	    state: rawInstance.state,
69	    flavor: rawInstance.flavor ?? null,
70	    isBuildVm: rawInstance.isBuildVm,
71	    deploymentId: rawInstance.deploymentId,
72	    createdAt: toDate(rawInstance.creationDate).toISOString(),
73	    deletedAt: toDate(rawInstance.deletionDate)?.toISOString() ?? null,
74	  };
75	}

I couldn't add the `clever instances` command: all three file writes were denied for lack of permission, so nothing in the repo has changed.

The writes I tried were:
- **New file:** `src/commands/instances/instances.command.js`. It is modelled on `status.command.js` and takes `--app`, `--alias` and `--format`. It calls the existing `listInstances({ ownerId, appId, onlyRunning: true })` from `src/models/instances.js`. `--format json` prints the instance list with `Logger.printJson`. The human output is a `formatTable` of number, ID, name, state, flavor, build or run, deployment and creation date. When nothing is running it prints "No instance is running for this application". It uses `since: null`.
- **`src/commands/global.commands.js`:** an `instancesCommand` import and an `instances: instancesCommand` entry after `help`.

Once you grant write access, I'll redo the edits. Then I'll run `npm run docs`, `npm run validate`, and `node bin/clever.js instances --help` to check it. `docs` needs network access, because it calls the public Clever Cloud API.

I filtered to running instances by default, so the list matches what `clever ssh` offers. If you'd rather list all instances, including deleted ones, say so and I'll add an option for it.
